items.quote: Green Guard Landscaping did an amazing job transforming our outdoor space. From the initial consultation to the completion of the project, the entire team was professional, organized, and easy to work with.
Levi was very professional and friendly. He was on time the day he gave me a quote and the day he was scheduled to start the work, he was there on time.
Honest, reliable, and great work. Highly recommended for small or large jobs.
